title: IN WHICH PASSEPARTOUT'S NOSE BECOMES OUTRAGEOUSLY LONG
summary_hover: Penniless in Japan, Passepartout joins an acrobatic troupe. During a performance, he spots Phileas Fogg and Aouda, reuniting to board the American steamer.
summary_detail: Stranded without money, Passepartout trades his clothes for Japanese garments to afford a small meal. To secure passage across the Pacific, he takes a job in the Honourable William Batulcar's acrobatic troupe as a base for a human pyramid. While performing, he spots Fogg and Aouda in the audience, breaking the formation to rush to them. After Fogg pays for the damages, they all board the American steamer together.
